scope: IG0 reference resource envelope and image-install manifest contract. This is not a packed runtime measurement and does not claim a minimum whole-machine RAM size.

supported_envelope.dimensions_policy: IG2 may advertise only 1024x1024 until another dimension has its own resource and quality evidence.

quantization_policy.selection: validated candidate from IG0 emulation evidence; packed Metal representation and protected tensor list are an IG2 gate
quantization_policy.must_not_claim: INT4 resource behavior from the BF16 reference measurements

text_encoder.qualification: cold-copy and reuse arms qualified; exact output and quiet windows passed

transformer.qualification: cold load, first execution, and resident phases qualified in quiet-05; all three reuse resident phases were phase-qualified in quiet-07, while reuse load and first execution were physically mixed

vae_decoder.qualification: cold-copy and reuse arms qualified; exact decoded output and quiet windows passed

swap.interpretation: Swap was already in use before the runs; no isolated minimum-RAM or swap-causality claim is made.

system_observations.physical_read_classification: cold-copy is disk-read when at least 90 percent of stored payload bytes are read; reuse is cached at most 1 percent and mixed otherwise. This classifies the observed file-cache regime, not a system-wide SSD purge.

headroom_policy.stage_ceiling_definition: A stage ceiling is the largest qualified fresh-process peak footprint for that stage. It includes framework allocations, live tensors, staging, allocator retention, and any unobservable MPS scratch present during the run.
headroom_policy.inclusive_non_parameter_definition: peak_process_footprint_bytes minus resident_parameter_bytes; this is an inclusive budget for activations, temporary tensors, staging, process overhead, allocator retention, and unknown MPS scratch, not an exact activation or scratch measurement
headroom_policy.ownership: Only one heavyweight stage owns managed GPU residency at a time. Conditioning and final latents may cross the stage boundary; heavyweight weights and their stage workspaces may not.
admission: Before a stage starts, account for its installed packed weights, conditioning or latent buffers, staging buffers, in-flight GPU work, and allocator-retained capacity.
Require current available system headroom in addition to the stage budget. The resource contract does not convert the 36 GB reference machine into a universal RAM minimum.
Refuse before execution when the stage lower bound or measured stage budget cannot fit. Do not begin execution and rely on swap.
Release the previous heavyweight stage and wait for its outstanding GPU and I/O consumers before admitting the next stage.
Do not sum the three fresh-process peak values as a simultaneous allocation. Repeated-job and resident-versus-streamed proof remains IG3.
headroom_policy.headroom_claim: The measured inclusive non-parameter budgets are the frozen accounting allowance for the reference envelope. IG2 must report packed-runtime values separately and may not label an unmeasured reduction as available headroom.
headroom_policy.latency_claim: Observed resident timings are reference observations, not a production SLA. IG2 records packed-runtime timings against this stage evidence.

manifest_contract.install_binding: The image manifest is covered by the existing verified-install.json receipt and file hash rules.

file_entry.hash: sha256 over the complete installed file payload
file_entry.shape_and_span_rule: Every required tensor has a name, shape, storage dtype, byte span, hash or file binding, and component owner.

quantization.nibble_order: must be declared by the installed kernel contract
quantization.scale_and_bias_convention: must be declared per packed tensor class
quantization.protected_tensor_names: must be explicit and non-empty for every component that mixes quantized and unquantized tensors
quantization.runtime_validation: IG2 must validate packed Metal output against the frozen IG1 component fixtures before marking an install runnable.

resource_envelope.stage_limits_are: per-stage inclusive process ceilings, not simultaneous allocations
resource_envelope.exact_scratch: unavailable; use the inclusive non-parameter accounting rule

verification.install_gate: Verify every declared file size and SHA-256 before marking installation complete.
verification.runtime_gate: Verify dimensions, batch, steps, forwards, guidance, tensor inventory, packed layout, and component ownership before execution.
verification.text_consumer_gate: Text-only consumers reject capability image-generation with a clear error.
